{{Quote|Always in service to the Confederacy, my Lord. Always.|Passel Argente, to Count Dooku|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref>}}
'''Passel Argente''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] who served as the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]] and a member of the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] representing his homeworld, [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]] in the final days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Following a protracted [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Argente pledged the Alliance's support for [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] before seceding from the Republic and taking a seat on the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]] as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] drove [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] into chaos. Taking the lead on a series of projects and operations during the war, Argente preferred to play a more administrative role during the war, remaining in the background while his more assertive colleagues on the Council planned and enacted their operations. Following the Council's move to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], their mysterious benefactor, [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], betrayed them by sending his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to slaughter Argente and his comrades.

==Biography==
===Early career===
{{Quote|We will do all we can to protect our assets and intellectual properties.|Passel Argente|<ref name="Holonet 48">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|48|business/13321_1.html|Corporate Alliance Attacks Slicer Compound}}</ref>}}
[[File:Koorivar_CT.png|thumb|left|250px|Argente as Magistrate of the CA]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Koorivar/Legends|Koorivar]] native to the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kooriva/Legends|Kooriva]], Passel Argente entered politics as well as the corporate world at an early age. The head of the powerful mercantile company [[Lethe Merchandising]], a company affiliated with the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]],<ref name="DL">''[[Dark Lord: The Rise of Darth Vader]]''</ref> Argente was also appointed [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of his homeworld and represented his people in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]]. Entering into the Senate during [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] second term, Argente's appointment came on the heels of his rise to [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]] of the Corporate Alliance. During his years on the Senate floor, Argente was often criticized for graft and corruption, and used his corporate connections to amass great wealth.<ref name="db" />

An outspoken opponent of Valorum and his weak stances on the protection of commerce and trade along the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], Argente was closely affiliated with other members of the Senate who wished to supplant the Chancellor. In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] Argente was invited to [[Ryloth/Legends|Rylothian]] Senator [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa's]] box at the [[Coruscant Opera/Legends|Coruscant Opera]], joining his colleagues [[Edcel Bar Gane/Legends|Edcel Bar Gane]], [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]] and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for a discussion on Valorum's ineffectiveness.<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref> Not long after, the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|blockaded]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], an event which eventually led the planet's [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|queen]], [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], to ask for a [[Vote of No Confidence/Legends|Vote of No Confidence]] in Valorum's leadership. One of the first to support Amidala's vote, Argente was pleased to see Valorum leave and Naboo's Senator [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] take up the Chancellorship.<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref>

Continuing to work in the Senate and lead the Corporate Alliance, Argente's security was overseen by Enforcer [[Jerv Riske]], a man who accompanied the Magistrate to the planet [[Barlok/Legends|Barlok]] in [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]] to negotiate a dispute between the Corporate Alliance and [[Guild Master/Legends|Guildmaster]] [[Gilfrome]] over a mining dispute. During the negotiations Argente was staying at the [[Starbright]] hotel; while the negotiations were underway, an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] attempted to kill Argente, but was thwarted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jorus C'baoth]].<ref name="Outbound Flight novel">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

During the two terms of Chancellor Palpatine, a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] plagued the Senate. During this time, Argente ordered an attack on the [[Fakir system/Legends|Fakir system's]] [[Yirt-4138-Grek-12]] to destroy an industrial espionage training facility. Argente issued a [[Hologram/Legends|holomessage]] to shareholders of the Corporate Alliance to inform them of the attack and its legitimacy regarding the protection of their holdings.<ref name="Holonet 48" /> Despite his sometimes questionable allegiances during this time period, Argente was known to have made a sizable donation on behalf of the Corporate Alliance to the [[Refugee Relief Movement/Legends|Refugee Relief Movement]].<ref name="Hnn-RRM Fundraiser a Huge Success">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|53|news/13425_4.html|RRM Fundraiser a Huge Success}}</ref>

===Joining the Confederacy===
{{Quote|I am authorized by the Corporate Alliance to sign the treaty.|Passel Argente|<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'' novelization]]</ref>}}
[[File:Passel_argente.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Argente at the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]]]
In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], as the Separatist movement began to pick up momentum, Argente was invited to a meeting on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] by [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], the leader of the Separatist cause. Accompanied by his aide, [[Denaria Kee/Legends|Denaria Kee]], Argente met with [[Viceroy/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]; [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]]; [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] Chairman of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]]; [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] [[Presidente/Legends|Presidente]] [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]], and several others. Pledging the Corporate Alliance's full funding and dedicating their enforcement branch to Dooku's cause, the group would soon be organized into the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Not long after the clandestine meeting concluded, Geonosis was [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|attacked]] by the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]], under the command of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. While taking shelter in a [[Geonosian War Room/Legends|hidden war room]], Argente and the other corporate heads fled the planet once it was clear that the Republic would take the world.<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref>

Renouncing his place in the Senate, Argente took a place on the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]], the leading governing organ of the Confederacy. Hoping to maintain a low profile on the war front and remain in the background manipulating events, Argente was not pleased when Dooku forced him to coordinate battles and oversee operations.<ref name="db" /> Argente funded and marketed both anti-[[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and anti-Republic propaganda, which helped keep the public in Confederate territory pro-war.

===Vying for power===
{{Quote|That ''Wat Tambor'' is up to something. I ''know'' it. The tide is turning, and I know someone's neck has to be in a noose. I know that they are eyeing mine. But I've got ''horn'' enough to know better!|Passel Argente to Gha Nachkt|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Discount">''[[The Clone Wars: Discount]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Argente_Discount.png|thumb|left|150px|Passel while meeting with [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]]]]
At the beginning of the war, Passel Argente briefly headed a plot to oust Count Dooku as leader of the CIS. He pushed for an early attack on the [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] facility at [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] to be headed by his pawn, the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Merai]]. He hoped that an early victory there would shut down the Republic's war-making capabilities before the war even began, and that he would be given credit for winning the war, garnering enough political support to overthrow Dooku. However, both [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] and Dooku were aware of this plot and arranged to have the Confederacy's battle plans leaked to [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Quinlan Vos/Legends|Quinlan Vos]] on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]], through Dooku's agent [[Tookarti]]. As a result, the outcome of the [[First Battle of Kamino]] was disastrous for the Confederacy, and instead of being hailed as a glorious leader, Passel Argente was deemed responsible for the failure and disgraced, which proved to be a fatal setback to his plans for a coup.<ref name="Republic 50">[[Republic 50|''Republic'' 50]]</ref>

Following his failed plot against Dooku, Argente learned that fellow Councilor [[Wat Tambor/Legends|Wat Tambor]], the [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]], was planning to move against him. Fearing that he would be assassinated, Argente met with a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]] named [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]] to purchase a droid to act as a spy for him. Unknown to Argente, Nachkt had already been bought by Foreman Tambor who had given him a spyware-infected [[RA-7 protocol droid/Legends|RA-7 protocol droid]] to present to Argente. Argente kept the infected droid close to him at all times in hopes of detecting any spyware aboard his ship; all the while unknowingly broadcasting covert business operations directly to Tambor. During one of these meetings, Argente's focus on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] piqued Tambor's interest in conquering the [[Ryloth system/Legends|system]], sparking the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Techno Union invasion]] of the planet.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Discount" />

===Conquering Ukio===
{{Quote|Time... time... what time now? When can we get moving?''"<br />"''Patience, Magistrate. These preparations must be completed with utmost precision. You do not want this grand endeavor to fail, not when we are so close to ''victory''.|Passel Argente and Doctor|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct" />}}
[[File:Passelrots.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Passel Argente wearing [[Gender/Legends|his]] oily [[Color/Legends|orange]] [[Robe/Legends|robe]]]]
Later in the war, Argente began to plot the invasion and conquest of a Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] called [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]]. Despite the presence of the Grand army and the Jedi Order on the planet, Argente was intent on striking a blow at the Republic and therefore commissioned the [[T-series tactical droid/Legends|T-series tactical droid]] [[Doctor (tactical droid)|Doctor]] to assist in the planning of [[Project Instinction]]. When in orbit around the planet, Argente's fleet dumped mass amounts of soil harvested from the planet [[Moorja/Legends|Moorja]] on the planetary shields protecting Ukio, effectively blocking out the sun. When the [[Ukian/Legends|Ukians]] were forced to lower their defenses to allow the soil to disperse, Argente's fleet dropped a series of strange weapons onto the planets surface. These devices, when activated, emitted an unusual frequency which caused non-[[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] to act vicious and bloodthirsty. While the Jedi stationed on the planet were able to destroy the devices and knock back Argente's attack, stocks invested in the planet's food supply plummeted, allowing Argente to effectively conquer the planet and all of its resources, robbing the Republic of a major supplier.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct" />

===Betrayal on Mustafar===
{{Quote|When my new apprentice, Darth Vader, arrives, he will take care of you.|Darth Sidious to the Separatist Council|<ref name="ROTS" />}}
As the war dragged on, Kooriva fell to the Republic as well as the other home and purseworlds of the Separatist leadership. As their homeworld's would not accept them, the members of the Council were forced to roam about space on their private vessels under the protection of [[Supreme Commander of the Droid Armies/Legends|Supreme Commander]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]]. Joining the Council aboard the [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Invisible Hand/Legends|''Invisible Hand'']], the leadership of the Confederacy was sent to the sinkhole world [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] to await further instructions. Following Dooku's death over [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] at one of the most tumultuous [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|battles]] of the war, Argente was present with the other Councilors at the meeting during which Grievous ordered them to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], a mining planet on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] where they were promised safety. Not long after departing Utapau, Grievous was killed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], and the Council took full control over the Confederacy.<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref>

[[File:Mission-to-Mustafar.png|thumb|left|250px|Passel Argente was eventually slain on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]].]]
As the Council arrived on Mustafar, they quickly settled into the dimly lit command center at the mountainside [[Klegger Corp Mining Facility/Legends|Klegger Corp Mining Facility]]. Argente and the other Confederacy leaders were pressed into work at the facility's command center, supervising strategy and battle plans from their remote sanctuary. During their stay, the Council received a communications from the mysterious [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]], the Confederacy's shadowy benefactor. Sidious promised that the war was over and that the Republic had crumbled under the Separatist's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|war machine]]. Advising the Council to remain on the planet, Sidious assured them that he would send his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], to watch over them. Relieved by the news of victory, Argente and the others anxiously awaited for Vader's arrival and their eventual departure from the inhospitable world. Upon Vader's landing, the Council and its aides gathered in the facility's main command center to greet Vader only to realize soon after he sealed off all of the exits to the facility that he was not there to protect them. Igniting his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Vader savagely cut down the guards flanking the doorway before attacking the unarmed Councilors and their aides. Denaria Kee, Argente's aide, was quickly stabbed while Argente was not swift enough to defend himself because he was swiftly killed by Vader's saber, suffering a fast decapitation and dying instantly.<ref name="ROTS" /> Soon after Argente's death, the Corporate Alliance relocated its distribution companies to the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]; with the death of Argente, the Corporate Alliance faded into oblivion.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|This is taking too ''long''. Or... it's happening ''too'' quickly. I don't know. I just don't ''like'' this!''"<br />"''Magistrate, please, try to calm yourself. Here, take your tea.''"<br />"''Why did he have to make it so complicated? So many moving parts. Too many moving parts!''"<br />"''The droid is doing what it is built to do, Magistrate. You must trust to its programming.''"<br />"''Is the Count still on schedule?''"<br />"''Yes, his shuttle has entered the system.''"<br />"''I despise waiting games! ''Despise'' them!|Passel Argente and Denaria Kee, during Project Instinction|<ref name="The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct" />}}
A corrupt and wheedling individual, Argente was often viewed as unaccountable by his peers and colleagues, unwilling to shoulder any responsibility or admit a mistake. Suspicious by nature, Argente did not feel guilty by blaming others for his failures, believing them all in the process of trying to undermine him in every venture he took. Even in his days as a Koorivar Senator, Argente was colored by graft and corruption brought upon by his strong ties to corporate interests. Often one to shirk personal accountability, Argente was more than willing to blame others for his shortcomings and mistakes. Like all Koorivar, Argente prized the shape and size of his cranial horn, a physical feature prized by the race the larger it was. He was completely obsessed with wealth. Throughout his political career, Argente wore various articles of clothing, including a [[shimmerbird]] tongue robe around the time of being a [[senator]] and a burnt orange robe with a [[Star/Legends|sun]]-like pattern on it while holding a position in the CIS. Like many Koorivar, Argente wore twine-like head wrappings.<ref name="db" />

==Behind the scenes==
Passel Argente was played by actor [[Steven Boyle]] in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref>{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/castcrew.html|text=Episode II Cast and Crew}}</ref> and by [[Marty Wetherill]] in [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III Revenge of the Sith]].<ref name="Starship>{{StarshipsVehiclesCite|51|Welcome On Board}}</ref>
